content: <thought>Based on the measured resistances, the simplest topology that fits is a series chain: X1 –R1– N_b1 –R2– (intermediate node) –R3– X2. The measured X1‑Nb1 resistance equals R1 (5 Ω). The Nb1‑X2 resistance equals the sum of the remaining two resistors, and the total X1‑X2 resistance equals the sum of all three. Solving R2+R3 = 13.333 Ω with the condition that one resistor is twice the other gives R2 ≈ 4.444 Ω and R3 ≈ 8.889 Ω. This satisfies all three measurements. The JSON below encodes the resistor values and their series connections.
